fields.subject: SQL Server Connection Settings
fields.trigger: the host binds the SqlDbConnections configuration array to SqlDbConnectionOptions
fields.response: represent each array entry as a SqlDbConnectionConfiguration that carries its DatabaseKey, accepts SqlClient connection settings directly on the entry (the database level, inherited from SqlConnectionPropertiesBase), and holds a ReadConnection and a WriteConnection that default to two distinct new SqlConnectionConfiguration instances when the entry does not configure them; and expose the same SqlDbConnections array, uncopied, as IDatabaseConfigurationOptions.DbConnectionsInternal with each entry's endpoints visible as ReadConnectionInternal and WriteConnectionInternal
fields.postcondition: the provider-neutral Databases collection reads every configured SQL Server database, with its database-level settings and its read/write connection pair, through the shared configuration interfaces
